name: claude-pet
description: A desktop pet that mirrors your Claude Code sessions

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && mkdir -p out/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/style.css out/renderer/
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
